readback_body:
## Description

The Linux Playwright baselines for the filtered Sessions screen still contain the retired outset focus halo. #2750 replaced that with a border repaint on bordered fields, so Full Regression reports a ~1% pixel diff on every non-tooling-only main push. The filtered 3-row state and the functional assertions are correct; only the baseline bytes and their migration-parity pins are stale.

## Reproduction

- Full Regression run 42462221057 at `b25a192133be4700925f8d64a3bc5066e94d2e5d`.
- `fixture-visual-app.spec.ts` (390×844) and `fixture-visual-app-compact.spec.ts` (375×812), test `Sessions layer, filtered`.
- Expected/actual/diff images show only the search input's outer focus halo.

## Root Cause

The two `app-sessions-filtered*-linux.png` baselines predate #2750 and still include the outset halo. `e2e/tests/browser/migration-parity.json` pins those old blob hashes.

## Impact

Main Full Regression is red for unrelated pushes; there is no product behavior failure.

## Fix Direction

Regenerate the two Linux baselines from the actual filtered state and update their migration-parity pins. Add a deterministic Case that checks the baseline/manifest agreement and the bordered-field focus contract.

## Location

- `e2e/tests/browser/__snapshots__/fixture-visual-app.spec.ts/app-sessions-filtered-linux.png`
- `e2e/tests/browser/__snapshots__/fixture-visual-app-compact.spec.ts/app-sessions-filtered-375-linux.png`
- `e2e/tests/browser/migration-parity.json`

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 The two filtered Sessions visual tests pass at the PR head with the quiet bordered-field focus treatment, and their Linux baseline bytes are pinned consistently in `migration-parity.json`.

## Acceptance Plan

```yaml

  SC-01:
    when: pr
    method: case
```
